'''SB-9''', short for '''Shutter-Bug-9''', was an imaging droid owned by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] during his short stint as baron administrator for [[Hologram Fun World]]. The droid had a camera built into his chest, and his eyes provided appropriate lighting and also had a strobe function.
